primarySource.citation: Cong, T. L., Bedjanian, E. and Dagaut, P. (2010), Oxidation of ethylene and propene in the presence of CO2 and H2O: Experimental and detailed kinetic modeling study, Combustion Science and Technology 182, 333-349.

benchmarks.measurementBasis: Molar ppm on the basis stored by ReSpecTh; no dry or reference-O2 correction is applied.

uncertainty.details: ReSpecTh labels these species-specific values as estimated standard deviations combining scatter and estimated uncertainty. They are not claimed as uncertainties reported by the primary paper.
